purpose: Live source reads for the TWC 2026 final-day desk and for every HotSpawn CS2 fixture the canonical board could not price like the featured picks. Each read records the URL, the minute-precision read time, and the exact figures copied out. No number on the published pages comes from anywhere else.
read_tool: research browser (fetch) from this session; HLTV, bo3.gg, HotSpawn and the official Valve standings repo were read directly, not through a cached copy

reads.note: Every TWC 2026 series played to 18 Oct, copied as shown. Used to verify days 1-4 line by line and to date the day-5 fixtures.

reads.source: HLTV news - Aurora roster rebuild (official announcements)

quotes: Aurora have announced the signing of kyxsan from Falcons to complete their summer rebuild with a new international IGL.

The move for the Macedonian in-game-leader follows the additions of Jimi 'Jimpphat' Salo and Ashley 'ash' Battye earlier on Friday, with the new trio replacing Engin 'MAJ3R' Kupeli, Caner 'soulfly' Kesici, and Sezgin 'Fabre' Kalayci.
Aurora are now: XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia, Jimpphat, kyxsan. Coach: ash.

corroborating.note: Timeline: Jul 2 bench MAJ3R and soulfly; Jul 3 sign Jimpphat and ashhh (coach); Jul 8 acquire kyxsan.
19-9-2026: first final for the new roster (StarSeries Fall), fifth event together.
16-10-2026: 'third consecutive top-four appearance' - the rebuild is now a known quantity.

data.conclusion: The roster change the brief refers to is real but it is the July 2026 international rebuild, not an October change, and no transfer in or out was visible on the team page on 18 Oct. It is therefore already in the market price and cannot be used to move a line; the flag stays published.

reads.source: HLTV news - day-1 result framed as an upset

quotes: 9z earned a statement win against the fifth-ranked team in the VRS, Aurora, to kick off this year's Thunderpick World Championship.
luchov topped the scoreboard with a 1.61 rating

corroborating.quote: leaving Aurora as the only favorite to falter in Malta after losing to 9z
9z delivered the first upset of the Thunderpick World Championship in Malta, beating World No.5 Aurora in two maps

data.conclusion: Aurora - not 9z - was the favorite. The Day-1 upset is a favorite losing at a LAN, which is the lesson used in the day-5 contrarian rules, not evidence that dogs are cheap here.

reads.source: bo3.gg tournament page - PGL Bucharest 2027: Closed Qualifier (the row the featured pipeline could not price)

data.join_evidence: HotSpawn fixture 1081546 is 'Apogee Betclic v BBL', tier B, PGL Bucharest 2027: Closed Qualifier, scheduled_start_time 1792418400000 = 2026-10-19T14:00:00Z, lock 13:54Z. bo3's own FAQ text says 'Betclic and BBL meeting in the upper-bracket final on 2026-10-19 at 14:00' - same two teams, same day, same hour, same event. The same page prices the earlier slot 'Betclic 2-0 Nemesis' (17 Oct), which is HotSpawn fixture 1081515 'Apogee Betclic v Nemesis' - a second agreeing join for the same alias.
data.identity_fix: HotSpawn's 'Apogee Betclic' is Betclic Apogee Esports, listed by Valve as 'Betclic'. Valve's 2026_10_05 file carries TWO 'Betclic' rows: #45 (1333 pts: Demho, ex1st, Prism, Qlocuu, ultimate) and #183 (765 pts: Demho, Dr3nquu, eskyy, hades, Prism). HLTV news 45096 'Betclic down to two players as hades leaves and Dr3nquu is benched' (9 Jul 2026) and 45273 'Betclic announce ultimate signing' (11 Aug 2026) identify #183 as the broken-up lineup and #45 as the current one: https://www.hltv.org/news/45096/betclic-down-to-two-players-as-hades-leaves-and-dr3nquu-is-benched
